correctness.rationale: Explicit LCF [-6,4,-4]^4 reconstructs a connected cubic triangle-free 12-vertex graph of 18 edges, diameter 3; an independent graph-isomorphism enumerator confirms exactly eight automorphisms. Integer graph distances make thresholds 0,1,2,3 exhaustive. At radius 1 the graph has cycle rank 18-12+1=7. At radius 2, independent 4095-mask enumeration gives 166 nonempty simplices with f=(12,46,68,36,4); independent deterministic Morse pairing has 82 pairs and an acyclic orientation of all 460 Hasse covers, with only one critical 0-cell and one 2-cell, proving integral S2. Radius 3 yields the full simplex. Independent signed Lefschetz traces under r:i->i+3 and s:i->-i give H1 (7,-3,1,-1,-1,-3,1,-1), H2 (1,-1,-1,1,1,-1,-1,1), matching the rational D4 decomposition and top integral sign. The inclusions kill positive homology at successive stages; the stated integral bars follow.
